basics.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Front-end platforms: React, TypeScript, performance

summary: Front-end platform engineer with 16+ years across the stack. Architected the React/TypeScript systems behind ServiceNow's low-code builders (Table Builder, Workspace Builder), owned front-end performance end to end, and set the testing and accessibility bar for surfaces other teams build on. Founded the Agentic Developer Platform (20+ teams) and shipped ALA to GA; led a 9-person team.

highlights: Owned front-end performance for the builder surfaces: profiled production regressions, fixed render and bundle hotspots, held performance budgets.
Stabilized Table Builder and Workspace Builder; grew Table Builder entry points 1→4, owned Studio support, UI/API fixes, and front-end architecture.
Drove ADP adoption: legacy test coverage <20% → 95% in 4 weeks across update sets, source control, and team dev; 7 pilot squads.
Shipped human-gated agent workflows (plan → approve → execute → verify) and instrumented agent quality in production; AI-native front-end patterns first-hand.
Tech-lead 9 engineers: ~60% hands-on coding, PR/architecture reviews, mentoring, cross-team coordination; Java/Glide full-stack ownership.
